entry.desc: Sums of tagged reaction rates, one group per entry in the form 'NAME = coef*TAG + TAG + ...', where TAG is the reaction tag without its tag_, usr_, cph_ or ion_ prefix and an entry ending in a plus sign continues on the next entry. A mechanism carrying O3S must define the O3S_Loss group, the ozone loss reactions whose summed rate divided by the O3 mixing ratio decays O3S below the tropopause. Source: CAM rate_diags.F90, namelist_defaults_cam.xml rxn_rate_sums
